#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
#define MOD 1000000007
#define MAX 33
typedef long long ll;
ll bin[66], n, m;
struct mat {
    ll a[MAX][MAX];
    mat operator*(const mat &o) const {
        mat r;
        memset(r.a, 0, sizeof(r.a));
        for (int i = 0; i <= m; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; ++j)
                for (int k = 0; k <= m; ++k)
                    r.a[i][j] = (r.a[i][j] + a[i][k] * o.a[k][j]) % MOD;
        return r;
    }
} ans, P[66][MAX], S[66][MAX], A[66][MAX];
ll read() {
    ll x = 0, f = 1;
    char ch = getchar();
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = -1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        x = x * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    return x * f;
}
signed main() {
    n = read(); m = read();
    ll tmp = n, len = 0;
    while (tmp) {
        bin[len++] = tmp % m;
        tmp /= m;
    }
    if (len == 0) len = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i <= m; ++i) ans.a[0][i] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= m; ++j) A[i][0].a[j][j] = 1;
        if (i == 0) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                A[i][j].a[m][m] = 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < m; ++k) {
                    if (k != j) {
                        A[i][j].a[k][k] = 1;
                        continue;
                    }
                    for (int l = 0; l <= m; ++l) A[i][j].a[k][l] = 1;
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                if (j == 0) A[i][j] = S[i-1][0];
                else A[i][j] = S[i-1][j] * P[i-1][j-1];
            }
        }
        P[i][0] = A[i][0];
        for (int j = 1; j < m; ++j) P[i][j] = P[i][j-1] * A[i][j];
        S[i][m-1] = A[i][m-1];
        for (int j = m-2; j >= 0; --j) S[i][j] = A[i][j] * S[i][j+1];
    }
    int idx = 0;
    for (int i = len-1; i >= 0; --i) {
        while (bin[i]-- > 0) {
            ans = ans * A[i][idx];
            ++idx;
            if (idx == m) idx = 0;
        }
    }
    cout << ans.a[0][m] << endl;
}
